personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, highly structured, and flexible marketplace where time and reliability are paramount.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm and native iOS margins. Cards never sit flush to the screen edge. Ensure bottom spacing accounts for the safe area and sticky CTAs.

do's: Bottom sheet drag handles and headers

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the value of time and trust, toggle language, and login via Google.

states.error: Standard alert or inline toast for failed auth

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim (0% to 80% surfaceInverse). Bilingual toggle (IT/EN) at top right. Brand wordmark and tagline in the bottom 40%, above a sticky Google Login button (surfaceSecondary bg, onSurface text).

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard to start a new mission or view active/upcoming bookings.

states.error: Error boundary with a retry button

screens.layout: Top section: Glass header with greeting. Section 1: Active/Upcoming mission card (surfaceSecondary, shadow 1) showing status. Section 2: 'What do you need?' - 2-column grid of image-backed category cards (Cleaning, Ironing) using gradient scrims and bottom-aligned text.

screens.name: Mission Creation Wizard
screens.purpose: Structured flow to define service, location, and time.
screens.layout: Progress bar at top. Single column form layout with generous spacing. Each step (Config, Location, Date/Time) is a separate view to avoid cognitive overload. Persistent sticky bottom CTA ('Next'/'Broadcast') over a glass background, leaving bottom padding for scroll clearance.

screens.name: Matching Radar
screens.purpose: Waiting screen (Modello D) while nearby providers accept the mission.

states.loading: Pulse animation expanding from center map pin
states.error: Timeout message with 'Expand search radius' CTA

screens.layout: Map view occupying the upper 60% with subtle radar pulse animations. Bottom 40% is a bottom-sheet (surfaceSecondary) showing real-time counters ('Invited 12, Accepted 2...') and a 'Cancel Request' secondary action.

screens.name: Provider Selection
screens.purpose: Compare and choose from providers who accepted the mission.

states.empty: Empty state illustration: 'No providers available right now.'

screens.layout: List view of cards. Each card displays provider avatar (or initials if missing logo/photo), rating, distance, price breakdown (Labor INPS + Jobby Fee). Primary 'Select Provider' button per card. Sticky bottom summary of the requested service.

screens.name: Provider Home
screens.purpose: Provider dashboard to manage incoming requests and availability.

states.empty: Illustration: 'No missions nearby. Take a break!'

screens.layout: Distinct UI structure from Customer: Top header features an 'Online/Offline' toggle. Split view: Top half is a map of incoming mission pings, bottom half is a scrollable list of 'Mission Requests'. Each card has clear 'Accept' / 'Decline' actions.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage identity, reviews, INPS wallet, and switch roles.
screens.layout: Profile header with avatar and rating badge. Prominent 'Switch to Provider/Customer' card at the top (brandTertiary bg for emphasis). Settings list (Language, Wallet/INPS setup, Support) using standard iOS list items with right chevrons.

onboarding_trust.alt: Two people shaking hands symbolizing trust and agreement

category_ironing.alt: Neatly folded clothes on an ironing board

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the No Blues/Purples rule for the brand. Use the Sage Green (#4A7B59) and Terracotta (#C57B57) palette to convey trust and warmth.
Implement the 'Modello D' workflow accurately: Mission Creation -> Radar Waiting Screen -> Provider Selection. These are separate steps.

The Role Switch functionality should be a prominent toggle or distinct card in the Profile tab, dynamically changing the Home layout between the 'Customer' booking view and the 'Provider' map/earnings view.
Apply gradient scrims (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to all category image cards and the onboarding background to ensure text readability.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' weight 400 and 500 exclusively. Avoid 600+ or bold weights; use size changes (e.g., xl or 2xl) to create hierarchy.
For sticky CTAs, use a fixed container at the screen root, styled with glass (expo-glass-effect or expo-blur) and leave corresponding bottom padding on the ScrollView so content isn't obscured.
